newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Soccer-Australia squad for round robin series.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Australia squad for round robin series.

text.p: The Australia squad announced on Friday for the January 18-26 four nations round robin series against New Zealand, Norway and South Korea:

Zeljko Kalac (Sydney United), Matthew Bingley (Marconi), Robbie Hooker (West Adelaide), Alex Tobin (Adelaide City), Milan Ivanovic (Adelaide City), Tony Popovic (Sydney United), Ernie Tapai (Collingwood), Robbie Enes (Sydney United), Paul Trimboli (South Melbourne), Craig Foster (Marconi), David Zdrilic (Sydney United), Milan Blagojevic (UTS Olympic), Dominic Longo (Marconi), Mark Babic (Sydney United), Goran Lozanovski (Collingwood), Jason Polak (South Melbourne), Alistair Edwards (UTS Olympic), Aytek Genc (Sydney United), Kris Trajanovski (UTS Olympic), Zeljko Babic (Marconi), Warren Spink (South Melbourne), Jason Petkovic (Adelaide City).
